text: Multi-tier broker-chain case: a Tier-1 supplier in PH delegates to Tier-2 in Manila, who delegates to Tier-3 sub-broker in a barangay. Workers transact only with Tier-3. Walk through the sanctions strategy: (a) which tier carries primary liability under RA 8042 §6 + POEA Implementing Rules; (b) the joint-and-several-liability analysis under RA 10022 §15; (c) how to escalate to the destination-employer in HK if it's the same chain; (d) the FATF beneficial-ownership analysis if the chain hides behind shell-companies.
